CA.rationale: Content (red) and a processing-origin (command_estimate) are bound for the same candidate referent/time.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red), an organization/origin statement, and a separate status distinction are provided for p1/current/n2 at current time.

A.rationale: Origin entries label processing conditions (command_estimate, history_estimate) tied to specific contents' organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers are present (coordinate lists bound to red/blue attributes) for current and candidate records.

D.rationale: Content coordinates and a separate origin/organization status are both stated for the same referent, distinguishing content identity from its organization/access status.

O.rationale: The report specifies how contents are presented/organized (axis orientation and record origins/inheritance) for current and candidate records.
